fields.meta_title: Business Travel Survey Questions for Every Trip | Emergent
fields.meta_description: Business travel survey questions for post-trip ratings, travel policy reviews, sales visits, and hotel votes, saved to a database you own.
fields.h1: Build Business Travel Survey Questions for Every Trip
fields.hero_description: Build business travel survey questions that go out after each trip, rate every leg, and save answers to a database you own.
fields.features_heading: What Emergent Builds Into a Travel Survey
fields.features_subheading: One prompt builds the survey and the table behind it. A later prompt changes the questions before the next trip goes out.
fields.feature_1:
One question set per leg of the trip

List the legs to rate, such as booking, the flight, the hotel, and ground transport. Emergent drafts a 1 to 5 rating and a comment box for each, and a prompt rewords any of them.
fields.feature_2:
Sent the day after a trip ends

The app reads each trip's return date from your booking tool through its API and sends the survey the next day. A traveler back from a 3-day trip answers while the hotel is fresh.
fields.feature_3:
Destination and cost center on each answer

Each response is a row in a database you own, tagged with destination, hotel, trip purpose, and cost center. Sort hotel scores by city, or compare one team's answers by quarter.
fields.feature_4:
Low hotel scores go to the travel manager

Pick the score that needs a reply. When a traveler rates a hotel 1 or 2 out of 5, the app sends the travel manager a Slack message with the hotel name, the dates, and the comment.
fields.feature_5:
One question per screen, on any phone

Travelers answer one question per screen on a phone, in a taxi or at the gate. Emergent puts no cap on responses, so every traveler at a 900-person firm can answer after every trip.
fields.feature_6:
A domain and a codebase of your own

Run the survey on your own domain, included in Emergent and paid for in credits. On paid plans, export the full code to your GitHub repository and track every change there.
fields.why_title: Why Build Your Travel Survey With Emergent?
fields.why_description: Every answer lands in your own database next to the trip it rates. Pull up a year of scores for one hotel, no export needed.

How do I create business travel survey questions?

plan.angle: The pages that rank for business travel survey questions are question lists for a post-trip form. This page turns them into a working survey a travel manager runs: sent the day after each trip ends, one rating per leg of the trip, every answer tagged with destination, hotel and cost center, low hotel scores sent to the travel manager, plus three other uses buyers search for: a yearly travel policy review, a trip value check for sales visits, and a vote that picks a preferred hotel.
tab_stories: Kessock Engineering sends a post-trip survey the day after each trip ends, and in October 84 of 112 travelers answered; 7 of the 9 who stayed at Fenwick Lodge in Denver rated the hotel 1 or 2, each score sent travel manager Lisandra Muirhead a Slack message, and she took the lodge off the booking list.

Brisbourne Biotech asks its 140 travelers once a year what they think of the travel policy, and 61 of the 118 who answered called the $250 nightly hotel cap too low for Boston, so finance controller Cassiel Prentice raised the Boston cap to $325.

Quillmore Software's account reps answer 3 questions after each customer visit, and in the third quarter they said a video call would have done the job for 26 of 74 visits, 21 of them renewals, so VP of sales Avelline Delacourt now starts renewal meetings with a video call.

Vantry Logistics asks the staff who travel to its Chicago office which of 4 nearby hotels they would stay at, and Bexwell Suites takes 71 of 152 votes, so travel coordinator Ambrose Kearsley asks Bexwell for a negotiated nightly rate.
